scripts.test: npm run test:contract && npm --prefix packages/admin-web test
scripts.test:contract: python3 scripts/check_public_contract.py && python3 scripts/check_repo_hygiene.py && python3 scripts/check_docs.py && npm --prefix packages/web test && go test -C packages/backend ./... -count=1
scripts.test:coverage: npm --prefix packages/web run test:coverage && npm --prefix packages/admin-web run test:coverage
scripts.lint: npm --prefix packages/web run lint && npm --prefix packages/admin-web run lint && npm run lint:go
scripts.fix: npm --prefix packages/web exec -- eslint --fix . && npm --prefix packages/admin-web exec -- eslint --fix . && gofmt -w packages/backend
scripts.check:circular: npx --yes madge --circular --extensions ts,tsx packages/web/src && npx --yes madge --circular --extensions ts,tsx packages/admin-web/src
